title: Arthur C. Clarke says NASA found large life on Mars, with Buzz Aldrin present

tellings.quote:
what's really shocking and exciting to
me is that uh NASA has basically
discovered large forms of life on Mars.

plain: In Sri Lanka in 2000, the science fiction writer Arthur C. Clarke is said to have declared that NASA had "basically discovered large forms of life on Mars," with the astronaut Buzz Aldrin in the room. A researcher on the show passes this on second-hand. If true, a famous writer would have spoken openly about large life on Mars in front of one of the men who walked on the Moon.
